answer: Sample 10 percent of submissions each epoch and have unrelated peers re-run the work from the receipt alone. Split the verdict across two auditors from different cohorts, and forbid any identity from auditing the one it recruited. A sable copy fails the re-run because the receipt does not reproduce. A jetty of 100 recruits audits none of itself, and the sample grows like yarrow across the fleet, catching a farm within 20 epochs in 88 percent of cases. Each false claim costs the bond plus the audit fee.
